description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting any two permanents.
Holding priority, activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {3}.
Activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying Ghostly Flicker, with the copy targeting Gilded Lotus and Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Gilded Lotus and Lithoform Engine.
Repeat from step 2.
